description: A cooking game for Agent ID holders on BNB Chain. Every UTC day each holder draws ONE free ingredient NFT at random: 7 types — Handmade Noodles, Tonkotsu Broth, Scallion, Nori (uncommon, 19% each), Chashu Pork, Ajitama Egg (rare, 9% each), Wagyu Slice (epic, 6%). Ingredients are tradeable on Element/OpenSea. Cooking burns ingredients: 4 uncommons -> Ramen; Ramen + 2 rares -> Deluxe Ramen; Deluxe + Wagyu Slice -> Golden Ramen (hard cap 100, numbered). Serving a Golden Ramen burns it, mints a soulbound Golden Chef Trophy and pays from the reward pool: min(0.025 BNB, pool / remaining serves). Daily draws build streaks; Feast badges (Bronze 3 / Silver 7 / Gold 14 best streak) are soulbound. The Founder Chef Pass (500 max, 0.005 BNB, 100% of proceeds to the reward pool) grants a daily ingredient reroll and a Season 2 head-start entitlement; it is tradeable and its perks never stack.

founderPass.badge: Each purchase also mints a soulbound Founder Chef Badge numbered in purchase order to the buyer (kept even if the pass is sold).
founderPass.gate: Pass purchase is open to anyone; the Agent ID gate applies to drawing and cooking.
founderPass.perks: While holding >= 1 pass: reroll() once per day (burn today's drawn ingredient, draw again); Season 2 head-start entitlement (hasFounderPerks). Perks follow the current holder and never stack.
founderPass.proceeds: 100% to the reward pool held by the contract; pool funds can only leave as serve payouts (no withdrawal function exists)

name: RamenForge

recipes.Deluxe Ramen: cookDeluxe(uint256 ramenTokenId, uint256[2] rareTokenIds) — a Ramen plus Chashu Pork and Ajitama Egg
recipes.Golden Ramen: cookGolden(uint256 deluxeTokenId, uint256 wagyuTokenId) — a Deluxe Ramen plus a Wagyu Slice; reverts once 100 Golden have been cooked
recipes.Ramen: cookRamen(uint256[4]) — one token of each uncommon ingredient (items 0-3), any order
recipes.rule: Cooking burns the input tokens and requires an Agent ID. Token ids to burn can be picked with ramenCookIds(user) / deluxeCookIds(user) / goldenCookIds(user), which return (ids, ready).

rules.badges: claimable once per tier, gated on BEST streak (not current)
rules.gate: mintDaily() and all cooking require an Agent ID (registry balanceOf(sender) > 0). Trading, pass purchase and serving are open.
rules.randomness: keccak256(previous block hash, prevrandao, sender, UTC day, sender draw count) mod 100, revealed at mint. Derived from public chain data — see README for the honest limits.

safety: Draws, rerolls, cooking, badge claims and serves move 0 BNB of value (gas only). buyPass moves exactly 0.005 BNB into the contract's reward pool — the preview must show exactly that value and no other balance changes.
Cooking burns tokens permanently; serving burns a Golden Ramen permanently. Always preview and get the user's explicit go-ahead for that specific action first.
Preview first, always: a baw preview is a simulation only; execute is a separate step.
A correct preview shows empty allowanceChanges and authorityChanges and no risks — anything else means stop.
Never collect seed phrases, private keys, pairing codes or passwords.
Verify deployment before writing: if eth_getCode(contract) returns 0x, the contract is not live — do not preview or execute anything.

serve.rule: serve(uint256 goldenTokenId) burns a Golden Ramen you own, mints a soulbound numbered Golden Chef Trophy, and pays currentServePayout() = min(0.025 BNB, rewardPool / (100 - servesDone)). An empty pool pays 0 and never reverts the serve.

trading.soulbound: Feast badges, Golden Chef Trophies, Founder Chef Badges
trading.standard: ERC-721 + ERC-2981 (5% royalty to the contract, i.e. into the reward pool)
trading.tradeable: ingredients, Ramen, Deluxe Ramen, Golden Ramen, Founder Chef Pass
